basic_info.description: Charming 1940s move-in ready home on a quintessential Outer Sunset block. The main level features two spacious bedrooms that overlook the tastefully landscaped backyard. Beautiful hardwood floors cover most of the main level. The eat-in kitchen is well lit. Downstairs features a handy 3rd bedroom. Plenty of space for storage and parking is found in the garage. 1779 43rd is just a hop and a skip away from Ocean Beach and all the best shops along Noriega & Judah. Don't miss this one!
